definition: Geospatial databases store and query data with geographic or geometric properties.
entry_text: Geospatial databases store and query data with geographic or geometric properties.
example: A transit planner queries a database for stops within walking distance of a clinic.
label: Geospatial databases

sources.note: Maintainer documentation sections 4.2 to 4.4 document storing and querying geographic coordinates and geometry in a spatially enabled database.
